package room

import (
	chess "example.com/auto-chess-practice/game/modules/autochess"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest/entitytimer"
	"time"
)

// TimerChessPhase 是自走棋阶段期限（准备期结束 / 战斗结算）在 Room 实体定时器上的类型号。类型号随节点存进 RoomDao，
// 发布后不要改号；同一个 Room 以后再装带定时器的模块（例如 turn 的 TurnDeadline），安装器会避开这里已用的号另分一个。
const TimerChessPhase int32 = 1

func (c *TimerComponent) registerTimerHandlers(h *entitytimer.Handlers) {
	h.Register(TimerChessPhase, func(f entitytimer.Fire) time.Duration {
		d := c.owner.Dao()
		if d.GetChessWakeTimer() != f.ID {
			return 0
		}
		s, e := chess.Decode(d.GetChessState())
		if e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
		if s.Deadline != f.Param1 || s.Deadline != f.Deadline.UnixMilli() {
			panic(chess.ErrRule)
		}
		if e = s.Advance(f.Now.UnixMilli()); e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
		d.SetChessState(s.Encode())
		d.SetChessWakeTimer(0)
		if s.Deadline > 0 {
			id := c.NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(s.Deadline), TimerChessPhase, s.Deadline, 0, nil)
			if id == 0 {
				panic(chess.ErrRule)
			}
			d.SetChessWakeTimer(id)
		}
		return 0
	})
}
